definition.simple: Tiny pipes inside a plant that carry water from the roots all the way up to the leaves.
definition.academic: The vascular tissue in plants that conducts water and dissolved nutrients upward from the root and also helps to form the woody element in the stem.

examples: When you put a celery stalk in colored water, the xylem tubes carry the dye up, turning the stalk colored.

common_misconceptions: Students often confuse Xylem and Phloem. Remember: Xylem starts with X/Z sound, close to W for Water. Phloem starts with F sound for Food.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student how water reaches the top of a very tall tree without a pump.
